scope: Narrow read-only peer review of the final UI69 block in design-workflows.spec.ts and its immediate producer/component/helper contracts.
verdict: No concrete TypeScript issue, locator mismatch or success-masking fallback found in this source review.
proof: domain.ts unavailable(reason) returns HTTP503. localAdmin() returns exactly local-operator-reader-not-bound after an original ok local-operator context.
Summary settings use a separate original handler; read() returns HTTP200 with refreshed context and validated settings after authority/source rechecks.
The UI mounts SfSummarySettings before and independently of the private Profile SfStatePanel. Therefore a503 private reader and a200 summary reader are coherent, distinct outcomes.
forwardOnce uses route.fetch with maxRedirects0/maxRetries0 and fulfills the unchanged original response before resolving. Test endpoints include exact origin, path and expected GET method.

The test decodes both responses through their exact schemas, asserts exact503 payload, absent Profile and unavailable region, then independently requires200, correct owner, configurable settings and nonempty producer catalog.

Checkbox values and checked state are compared with original availablePages/pages; version is tied to the original response. First checkbox is explicitly matched to the first producer item before toggling.

The actual review DOM contains data-component=sf-change-review, sf-s03-comparison-field[data-difference=changed], sf-s03-version[data-version=proposed] and sf-s03-value-list. The list renderer always emits ul, including for an empty list.
Cancel in the component only closes review; save is called from confirmation only. The test checks review removal, form visibility and zero observed POSTs to the exact configure-summaries endpoint.
limitations: Read-only source review; no CI, build, runtime or typecheck was executed.
